name: StaggeredMenu-TS-TW
blurb: Full-screen menu slides out with staggered animated items.
description: Slide-out navigation panel triggered by toggle button. Menu items and social links animate in staggered sequence; animated plus/minus icon and color transitions driven by GSAP.
use_when: Premium full-screen navigation requiring elaborate entry animations and responsive state-driven interactions.
avoid_when: On small screens where large slideout panels are cramped. Adds GSAP dependency and animation overhead.
a11y: Semantic with ARIA labels and roles (menuitem, list). Menu items not keyboard navigable; toggle button accessible. No prefers-reduced-motion support.
